description: The shrink-only fallback of OCD's published MMS-ended list (rule round 32, MMS override rule 6): the networks whose MMS end OCD recorded on 2026-10-09 and that generated/operators/statements.json does not cover yet, because no operator page of theirs could be admitted. The owner build reads the published mms_ended_networks of its pinned commit first and this file only for networks the published list does not name; it never tests MMS on either (round 26 rule change 6). A network leaves this file once the published list covers it, and the file goes once it is empty. Everywhere else MMS stays a test target, checked only by a silent MMSC reachability probe, never by sending an MMS.
source: OCD private repository, research/rule-decisions-20261006/mms-operator-ends-20261009.json (researched 2026-10-09), the rows with mms_status ended and confidence high, shrunk on 2026-10-29 by the networks the published list covers (26202, 26203, 26207, 26223, 22802, 22803, 27001; private #230)
